svg.text: what the cameras can see: 18 m
obstacle sensing · stereo vision range · stopping distance
small stereo cameras see ~18 m; at 16 m/s it needs 23 m to stop
with avoidance on, cap the speed at what it can stop inside what it sees

text.tspan: # why 18 m: depth error grows as z² / (f · baseline), and the baseline is 5 cm
# the fastest mode switches avoidance off: there it can't stop in time
